title: One global context budget sized for the 1M window
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16 ('czemu tak mało, skoro opus ma 1m context window?', 'zrobić jeden globalny setup'); research .krn/runs/lead/context-research.md: Opus 5.5 has a native 1M window (no [1m] suffix needed per code.claude.com model-config); the budget is our own: ~/.claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.json autoCompactWindow 400000, host fallback 400000 in src/context/gauge.ts, advisories capped at 150k/200k (advisoriesOf); a fresh boilerplate-2026 session starts at 38-46k. The context-usage.py relay allowlist entry in src/context/gauge.ts (relayCommand regex) is now dead (skill dropped it in Rekurencja/rekurencja-skills#17).
Outcome: one global source for the context budget: the gauge window comes from ~/.claude/settings.json autoCompactWindow (repo override only when set), the advisory caps are re-derived from measured outcomes on the corrected gauge (t-xv3jv5y) and documented with their evidence, krn/.claude/settings.json drops its duplicate, and the context-usage.py allowlist entry is gone; `node --test test/claude/context-gauge.test.ts` passes with a 600k global window yielding advisories from the new rule.
Why: leads hand off with most of the window unused; two budgets in two places disagree.
Proof: node --test test/claude/context-gauge.test.ts
Files: src/context/gauge.ts, ~/.claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.json
